verdict.stance: Neutral / Global Lowest-Cost Natural Soda Ash Leader Navigating 2026 Trough
verdict.summary: WE Soda (Ciner Group, UK-incorporated) is the world's largest natural soda ash producer with first-quartile solution-mining assets in Turkey (Eti Soda, Kazan) and the US (Genesis Alkali, acquired 2025). Global soda ash oversupply cut 2026E consolidated EBITDA guidance to ~$540m (lifting leverage from 3.3x to ~4.4x), keeping focus on liquidity ($400m-$700m+) and Restricted Group cash sweeps.

positives: Lowest-cost global natural soda ash production (Turkey solution mining + US Green River trona) vs synthetic Solvay peers.
Geographic diversification into US via 2025 Genesis Alkali acquisition.
Substantial liquidity ($400m-$700m+) bolstered by EBRD and syndicated facilities.
negatives: Global soda ash price trough compresses FY26E consolidated EBITDA to ~$540m (vs ~$710m FY25 proforma).
Consolidated net leverage projected to rise from 3.3x (FY25) to ~4.4x (FY26E).
High 9.375%-9.50% coupon burden and Restricted vs Unrestricted US perimeter complexity.
